escalation_note: Increases acute coronary and hemorrhagic stroke severity

name: Type 2 Diabetes
escalation_note: Can mask typical angina symptoms and predisposes to DKA/Sepsis

name: Coronary Artery Disease
escalation_note: High baseline probability of recurrent acute ischemia

name: Asthma / COPD
escalation_note: Rapid decompensation risk during respiratory distress

name: Immunocompromised State
escalation_note: Accelerates sepsis and CNS infection progression

name: Anticoagulant Therapy
escalation_note: High intracranial hemorrhage risk with sudden headache or trauma

name: Age >= 65 Years
escalation_note: Reduces physiological reserve and elevates sepsis/cardiac risk
